svg.title: EP2 C1 AREA 02
svg.desc: Temple is switch-heavy. Follow the numbered rooms and mechanism markers, and regroup only after each split is complete. Follow rooms 1→5; 4a is an optional Scape Doll branch. A short map, but with many enemies. Watch for the Foie trap on your left as you enter room 2; clear the room, then head north. After clearing room 3, go east to A and warp to A′. The boxes north of 4a hold a Scape Doll, 3 weapon boxes and 2 armor boxes, with a healing ring nearby. One Hunter can collect them alone while the rest push east. In the hallway from 4 to 5, hug the right (south) side to avoid the traps and open boxes as you go.
